## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the behaviour that changed (`cargo test -p glasscode_core -- --test-threads=1`, `cargo test`)
- [ ] A line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`, if a person sees the change
- [ ] No secrets and no personal data in code, tests, sample data or this text
- [ ] No new dependency and no change in `vendor/` without the owners' agreement (a new dependency names its licence here)
